title: Satwik-Chirag Humbled in First Round by Thai Pair
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, faced an unexpected early exit from a major tournament.
summary: The world No.5 Indian men's doubles pair was defeated by the spirited Thai pairing of Pakkapon Teeraratsakul and Peeratchai Sukphun in the first round.

title: National Coaching Camp for World Junior Championships Kicks Off in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's young talents for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: A national coaching camp has commenced at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare Indian juniors for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Badminton Stars Face Challenging Draws at Asian Games 2026
indian_angle: Top Indian shuttlers like Lakshya Sen and PV Sindhu face difficult paths in the Asian Games 2026, while Satwik-Chirag have a comparatively easier draw.
summary: The draws for the Asian Games 2026 badminton events reveal tough challenges for India's singles players Lakshya Sen and PV Sindhu, though the men's team has already secured a bronze.

title: BAI Hosts Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the coaching standards across India, vital for developing future badminton champions.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at NCE Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: India Holds Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships

summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.
